name: image-upload
title: Image upload
description: Thumbnail grid with remove buttons, a cover label and a drop tile. Limits count, type and size.
htmlExample:
<bef-image-upload id="iu" style="width:420px"></bef-image-upload>
<script>const iu = document.getElementById('iu'); const setImgs = (files) => iu.props = { files, onFilesChange: setImgs }; setImgs([]);</script>
